description: Flat metadata schema for individual observations from rodent brain-slice patch-clamp electrophysiology experiments assessing pharmacological modulation of neurotransmitter receptors and synaptic plasticity.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record/observation.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking records to the parent study or experiment series.

species.descr: Rodent species used in the experiment, e.g., 'Rattus norvegicus' or 'Mus musculus'.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the animal, e.g., 'male', 'female', 'mixed', or 'unknown'.

age_postnatal_days.descr: Age of the animal at the time of slice preparation, in postnatal days (P).

weight_g.descr: Body weight of the animal in grams at the time of experiment, if reported.

brain_region.descr: Brain region from which the slice was prepared, e.g., hippocampus CA1, cortex, striatum.

subregion.descr: More specific anatomical subregion or layer, if applicable, e.g., 'CA1 stratum radiatum'.

slice_type.descr: Type of slice preparation, e.g., acute coronal, sagittal, horizontal.

slice_thickness_um.descr: Thickness of the brain slice in micrometers (µm).

recording_technique.descr: Electrophysiological recording method, typically patch-clamp; specify whole-cell, voltage-clamp, or current-clamp when known.

cell_type.descr: Recorded cell type or neuronal population, e.g., pyramidal neuron, interneuron.

synaptic_pathway.descr: Synaptic input or pathway measured, e.g., Schaffer collateral-CA1, corticostriatal, mossy fiber.

recording_temperature_c.descr: Temperature of the recording chamber in degrees Celsius (°C).

solution_extracellular.descr: Key features or composition notes of the extracellular/artificial cerebrospinal fluid used for recording, if relevant.

solution_intracellular.descr: Key features or composition notes of the patch pipette/internal solution used, if relevant.

pharmacological_agent.descr: Pharmacological compound applied to modulate neurotransmitter release or receptor signaling, e.g., agonist, antagonist, inhibitor name.

agent_target_receptor.descr: Primary neurotransmitter receptor or transporter targeted by the pharmacological agent, e.g., NMDA receptor, GABA_A receptor, dopamine D2 receptor.

neurotransmitter_system.descr: Neurotransmitter system investigated, e.g., glutamatergic, GABAergic, dopaminergic, cholinergic, serotonergic.

agent_action_mode.descr: Mechanistic class of the manipulation, e.g., agonist, antagonist, partial agonist, inverse agonist, reuptake inhibitor, allosteric modulator.

agent_concentration_uM.descr: Final bath or pipette concentration of the pharmacological agent in micromolar (µM).

agent_application_route.descr: Route of application, e.g., bath, pressure puff, focal uncaging, intracellular dialysis.

agent_application_duration_min.descr: Duration of agent application in minutes, if applicable.

control_condition.descr: Comparator or baseline condition used for the causal inference, e.g., vehicle, no drug, baseline stimulation.

causal_interaction_type.descr: Type of causal relationship tested, e.g., receptor activation causes increased synaptic transmission, receptor blockade prevents plasticity induction.

causal_effect_direction.descr: Direction of the observed effect on synaptic transmission or plasticity, e.g., increase, decrease, no effect, bidirectional.

synaptic_plasticity_type.descr: Plasticity phenotype measured, e.g., LTP, LTD, paired-pulse facilitation, short-term depression, homeostatic plasticity.

plasticity_induction_protocol.descr: Stimulation protocol used to induce plasticity, e.g., theta-burst stimulation, high-frequency stimulation, pairing protocol.

stimulus_frequency_hz.descr: Stimulus frequency used during induction or response testing, in hertz (Hz), when applicable.

stimulus_intensity_pa.descr: Electrical stimulation intensity or amplitude used, with units as reported (e.g., pA, µA, V); store numeric value if standardized in the study.

baseline_amplitude_pA.descr: Baseline evoked response amplitude before manipulation, in picoamperes (pA), if applicable.

post_treatment_amplitude_pA.descr: Evoked response amplitude after treatment or induction, in picoamperes (pA), if applicable.

percent_change_response.descr: Percent change in synaptic response relative to control or baseline.

latency_ms.descr: Response latency in milliseconds (ms), if reported.

paired_pulse_ratio.descr: Paired-pulse ratio or paired-pulse facilitation metric, if measured.

membrane_potential_mv.descr: Holding or resting membrane potential in millivolts (mV), if relevant.

series_resistance_mohm.descr: Series resistance during recording in megaohms (MΩ).

sample_size_n.descr: Number of cells or slices contributing to this observation.

animal_n.descr: Number of animals contributing to this observation.

statistical_significance.descr: Whether the reported effect was statistically significant in the source study.

p_value.descr: Reported p-value for the key comparison, if available.

effect_size.descr: Reported effect size for the causal effect or plasticity outcome, if available.

measurement_units.descr: Primary units used for the principal electrophysiological outcome, e.g., pA, mV, Hz, ratio.

replication_status.descr: Whether the finding was independently replicated, e.g., 'replicated', 'not replicated', 'single study'.

supporting_publication_title.descr: Title of the published study supporting the finding.

supporting_publication_authors.descr: First author or key author list string for the supporting publication.

supporting_publication_year.descr: Year the supporting publication was published.

supporting_publication_doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for the supporting publication, if available.

supporting_publication_pmid.descr: PubMed ID for the supporting publication, if available.

supporting_publication_citation.descr: Full citation text for the supporting publication.

notes.descr: Any additional free-text notes needed to interpret the observation, including caveats or unusual protocol details.
